description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder, which handles percent-encoding operations such as encoding and normalizing URIs. It provides methods to encode non-reserved characters and fix up percent-encoded strings by decoding unreserved characters and normalizing them.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder
classes.description: A class for handling percent-encoding operations in URIs, including encoding, normalization, and managing reserved characters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the set of characters to preserve based on the argument.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string by percent-encoding all non-preserved characters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a percent-encoded string by decoding unreserved characters and ensuring proper percent-encoding format.
